items.title: Synopsys (SNPS) Joins European Chips Design Platform For Startups And Mid Sized Firms
items.summary: Synopsys (NasdaqGS:SNPS) has entered an agreement with the European Chips Joint Undertaking to support the European Chips Design Platform. The collaboration targets startups and medium-sized semiconductor firms that need access to advanced electronic design automation tools for chip development. The program is intended to back work on AI, high-performance computing and photonics within the European semiconductor ecosystem.
